Get early access

Still believe in manifesting, but your life didn’t get the memo? Hi.

Your vision board is a museum of a life you’re not living.

ISSUE11 is the manifestation app for people done with wishful thinking. Make your own magazine about the life you want, then live it one small move a week.

Request access

Private beta opens Dec 11, with invites for the waitlist. Founding members pay $39.99 for the first year (then $69.99/yr). Invite-only.
The yearly plan includes a 7-day free trial. Skip any week, no streaks. Cancel anytime in your iPhone settings. iPhone only.

WHY NOTHING’S CHANGED

Manifestation doesn’t work.

At least not the way you’ve been doing it. You wrote the affirmations, made the board, did the meditations and waited for the universe to do its part. Then December looked exactly like January.

One small move a week, never a to-do list

Your Issue fills up with things you actually did

Your Editor never rewrites your words

WRITE IT INTO BEING

Write the day you want, down to the outfit.

Where you wake up, what you do first, how it feels. It stays private in Scribe, and you pick which lines go in your Issue.

Journal with Scribe

Get guidance from your Editor

Turn your words into magazine stories

OKAY. HERE’S THE PLAN.

Manifesting, focused on what you can control.

Wishing alone doesn’t change a life. What you do every week does. ISSUE11 is built on behavior-change psychology: see the life you want clearly, then practice it in small steps (the morning, the workout, the hard email) until it’s simply how you live.

01

Choose it.

Add photos of the life you want, heart the images you love, and write it in your own words.

02

Make it.

Create your own magazine about that life, right in the app. Your Editor, the AI built into ISSUE11, helps design every page.

03

Live it.

Each week you get one small move toward a page you love. Do it, add a photo, and watch your Issue fill up with things you actually did.

INSIDE ISSUE11

Tools that go further than wishful thinking.

Yes, there’s a printed magazine.

Meditations that rehearse the steps, not just the dream.

5 or 10 minute guided sessions, a voice over soft music with visuals. Practice the morning, the workout, the hard email, so doing them for real feels normal.

Make your own magazine about your future.

Build it page by page from your photos and words, with your name on the cover. You’re the art director: tell your Editor what to change.

Hold your future in your hands.

Order your finished Issue as a printed magazine for $29.99. Leave it on the coffee table and let people ask.

Where the life you want takes shape.

Add your photos and heart the images of the life you’re going for. Your magazine and weekly moves are built from them.

A small nudge, never a to-do list.

Your Editor suggests one move toward a page you love. Skip it, shrink it, or do it and add a photo.

INSIDE THE APP

A closer look inside ISSUE11.

Explore visual collections, journal your next chapter, and create your magazine with the Editor’s help. Step into immersive meditations, then bring your finished Issue into print.

We built ISSUE11 to give people a place to focus on the life they want, design it, and start creating their own reality. So much of what we do on our phones pulls us away from ourselves. We wanted to make something that brings us back.

Megan Scott Manolova

Founder & Creative Director, ISSUE11

THAT LIFE HAS WAITED LONG ENOUGH

Stop manifesting from the couch. Live the life you saved.

Get your invite before the Dec 11 beta and lock in $39.99 for your first year.

Request access
